chapter.heading: Israel Restored at Last
chapter.v:
O Israel,
return to the Lord your God,For you have stumbled because of your iniquity;

Take words
with you,And return to the Lord.Say to Him,“Take away all iniquity;Receive us graciously,For we will offer the sacrifices of our lips. [Rom. 16:3; 1 Cor. 16:19; 2 Tim.]

Assyria shall
not save us,We will not ride on horses,Nor will we say anymore to the work of our hands, ‘You are our gods.’For in You the fatherless finds mercy.” [Acts 20:34; 1 Cor. 4:12; 9:14; 2 Cor. 11:7; 12:13; 1 Thess. 2:9; 4:11; 2 Thess. 3:8]

“I will
heal their backsliding,I will love them freely,For My anger has turned away from him. [Acts 17:2]

I will
be like the dew to Israel;He shall grow like the lily,And lengthen his roots like Lebanon. [Acts 18:28] [Acts 17:14,]

His branches
shall spread;His beauty shall be like an olive tree,And his fragrance like Lebanon. [Acts 13:46-48;] [Neh. 5:13; Matt. 10:14; Acts 13:51] [Acts 13:45] [Lev. 20:9, 11, 12;]

Those who
dwell under his shadow shall return;They shall be revived like grain,And grow like a vine.Their scent shall be like the wine of Lebanon.

“Ephraim shall
say, ‘What have I to do anymore with idols?’I have heard and observed him.I am like a green cypress tree;Your fruit is found in Me.” [1 Cor. 1:14]

Who is
wise?Let him understand these things.Who is prudent?Let him know them.For the ways of the Lord are right;The righteous walk in them,But transgressors stumble in them. [Acts 23:11]
